member.name: M:WebApplication1.Controllers.AuthController.Csrf(Microsoft.AspNetCore.Antiforgery.IAntiforgery)
member.summary: Get a CSRF token for write requests.
member.remarks: Swagger does this automatically. React must send the token in X-CSRF-TOKEN and refresh it after login/logout.

member.name: M:WebApplication1.Controllers.AuthController.Register(WebApplication1.DTOs.RegisterRequest)
member.summary: Register a user and sign in.
member.remarks: Use a valid email and an 8–128 character password. Returns the user and sets an HttpOnly login cookie.

member.name: M:WebApplication1.Controllers.AuthController.Login(WebApplication1.DTOs.LoginRequest)
member.summary: Sign in and retrieve your saved personal best.
member.remarks: Sets the authentication cookie. A null bestGuesses means no completed game yet.

member.name: M:WebApplication1.Controllers.AuthController.Logout
member.summary: Sign out by clearing the browser's login cookie.
member.remarks: Requires login. Does not delete the user or their personal best.

member.name: M:WebApplication1.Controllers.AuthController.Me
member.summary: Read the authenticated user and their personal best.

member.name: M:WebApplication1.Controllers.GameController.Current
member.summary: Read whether a game is active and its current guess count.
member.remarks: Requires login. The secret number is never included in responses.

member.name: M:WebApplication1.Controllers.GameController.Start
member.summary: Start a new game with a secret number from 1 through 43.
member.remarks: Requires login. Replaces any unfinished round and resets the count to zero. No request body is needed.

member.name: M:WebApplication1.Controllers.GameController.Guess(WebApplication1.DTOs.GuessRequest)
member.summary: Submit a guess and receive guess higher, guess lower, or correct.
member.remarks: Requires login and an active game. Send an integer from 1 through 43. Valid guesses count automatically; a winning score updates the personal best only if it improves it. A 409 means no active game or a concurrent update; refresh the current game.
